query: I'm evaluating a 95-year-old man. Among male Medicare patients aged 90–100 admitted as transfers from another hospital with a principal diagnosis of end-stage renal disease (ICD-9 585.6 or ICD-10 N18.6), how many admissions occur in the dataset during the study period?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN transfers t ON a.subject_id = t.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 95 AND p.anchor_year >= 2019 AND p.anchor_year <= 2021 AND (d.icd_code = '585.6' OR d.icd_code = 'N18.6') AND t.eventtype = 'transfer';
